source.name: Charlotte FC: 'Charlotte FC Names Frigidaire as First-Ever Back-of-Kit Partner'
source.quote: logo will appear below player numbers on the back of all Charlotte FC kits
source.note: Full sentence on the page: 'Beginning with this weekend's match against the Columbus Crew, the Frigidaire® logo will appear below player numbers on the back of all Charlotte FC kits.' No deal value was reported.

note: First-ever back-of-kit partner, announced under the MLS back-of-jersey ad platform introduced after the 2026 All-Star break; the logo debuted at the home match against Columbus Crew in August 2026.
